name: PRINTFILM v0.3 AI Short Video and Drama Studio
description: AI short video and short drama studio: script to storyboard to final cut.

images.api: built from python:3.12.16-slim-bookworm@sha256:935c3c5b12357a7e10caa9c1e6ca5692344d97cf229832ef584be2cec9fc03df + Debian ffmpeg and fonts-wqy-zenhei

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and Railway's healthcheck (/healthz) use it.

PRINTFILM_API.description: Private host:port of the API service; /api/*, /static/* and /epay/notify are forwarded there.

PORT.description: Port Caddy listens on; the public domain and Railway's healthcheck (/healthz) use it.

PRINTFILM_API.description: Private host:port of the API service; /api/* and /static/* are forwarded there.

PORT.description: API port (one dual-stack socket on ::). Railway's healthcheck calls /api/health here.

TOKENFREE_API_KEY.description: Optional at deploy, needed to generate: TokenFree API key (sk-...) for scripts, images, video and voice. Can be added later in Admin -> System settings -> Models.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Login of the admin account the pre-deploy step creates (also signs in to the studio). An invalid address falls back to admin@example.com.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password, generated (12+ characters). Applied on every deploy, so a password changed in the app is reset to this value.

SECRET_KEY.description: Signs logins and encrypts the saved TokenFree key; generated. Changing it signs everyone out and makes saved keys unreadable.

PRINTFILM_SIGNUP_ENABLED.description: true lets anyone who opens the site register. Off by default: every account generates on your TokenFree key unless billing is on.

PRINTFILM_PUBLIC_MEDIA_URLS.description: Hand Seedance local media as https://{web-domain}/static/... URLs while Aliyun OSS is off (needed for video from uploaded or older images). false = upstream behaviour.

PRINTFILM_FFMPEG_THREADS.description: FFmpeg threads per process: auto = the service's CPU limit (max 8), a number to set it, 0 = FFmpeg's own choice (host CPU count).

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public address of the studio (reset links, media URLs). Read on the first start only; afterwards change it in Admin -> System settings -> Site.

CORS_ORIGINS.description: Origins allowed to call the API from a browser (both fronts are same-origin proxies; add a custom domain here if you call the API directly).

MODEL_LLM.description: Default text model on the first start (upstream's Docker default); afterwards chosen in Admin -> System settings -> Models.

MODEL_IMAGE.description: Default image model on the first start (upstream's Docker default); afterwards chosen in the admin console.

MODEL_VIDEO.description: Default video model on the first start (upstream's Docker default); afterwards chosen in the admin console.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL over the private network; start.sh turns it into upstream's postgresql+asyncpg / psycopg2 URLs.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis over the private network: live progress events and password-reset tokens.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds a redeploy gives the API to stop its task runtime cleanly; unfinished jobs are picked up again after the restart.

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized

PGDATABASE.description: Required variable for the data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Database created on first boot; PRINTFILM creates its tables here (pre-deploy and at API start).

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection string; the API references it.

POSTGRES_USER.description: User to connect to Postgres DB

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Superuser password, generated at deploy (letters only, so it is safe inside DATABASE_URL).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to cleanly shut down

REDISHOST.description: Private network hostname of the Redis service, only resolvable from services in the same environment

REDIS_URL.description: Connection string for connecting to Redis using the private network

REDISPASSWORD.description: Alias of REDIS_PASSWORD for clients that expect the unseparated name

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Randomly generated password for authenticating with Redis
